arguments.sql: SELECT SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_transactions FROM fraud_labels f WHERE f.is_fraud = 1
arguments.explanation: Counts the labelled transactions marked as fraud (is_fraud = 1) in the fraud labels table.
assumptions: Counted over the fraud_labels table; every label row is a labelled transaction, and the count covers all dates in the data (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31).
